qs.q: Allosteric regulation of an enzyme typically involves:
o: D. Enzyme amount changes via synthesis or degradation
C. Molecule occupies the active site, blocking substrate entry
B. Enzyme undergoes covalent modification such as phosphorylation
A. Effector binds away from the active site, altering enzyme shape
qs.e: Allosteric regulation involves the binding of an effector molecule to an allosteric site (a site distinct from the active site) on the enzyme. This binding induces a conformational change that affects the enzyme's activity, either activating or inhibiting it.
